title: [Audit 4.7] Instrument file import (ICP/AAS/UV-Vis CSV)
body:
Closes #200

Instrument CSV/TXT/XLSX files can now be mapped to the actual run's instrument and previewed before an atomic import. Unknown IDs stay listed and skipped; any matched-row conflict refuses the file with zero writes. Successful imports create exact raw sample drafts and pending QC observations through the existing owners, with one immutable source receipt. Final recording, calculation and QC evaluation remain explicit actions.

The workbench includes a scoped column-mapping wizard and immutable mapping revisions, current local calculation input definitions, all five languages, per-cell issues and preview invalidation on file/sheet/mapping changes. Paste now matches laboratory label codes and handles comma, semicolon and tab delimiters. XLSX uses exact stored cell evidence and the latest pinned separator-only, verified lab-number round trip; the shared parser and ordinary typed-writer behavior are unchanged.

Validation (normal Jest global setup, real owners, no skips or weakened assertions; groups overlap):
- Backend at dc032759: 10 suites / 301 tests / 0 skipped PASS, 55.099s. Includes full 40 samples × four analytes + six QC rows (160 drafts, 24 pending observations, one unknown ID), EXCH_CA/Olsen activated inputs and later actual typed recording, source/parse/unit/refusal cases, both schema predecessors and integrity scanner.
- UI/paste/calculation UI/scanner at ecf4c6d4: 4 suites / 138 tests / 0 skipped PASS, 11.781s; real FormData, revision scope, stale responses, dirty/file/sheet invalidation and refusal controls.
- Populated installer/commit/ICP/calculation/UI/scanner at 8aeeb095: 6 suites / 221 tests / 0 skipped PASS, 29.637s.
- `cd client && npm run build`: PASS, 17.919s. `npm run lint`: PASS, 0 errors / same 14 existing warnings, 8.671s. Client source has not changed since ecf4c6d4.
- Prior focused head a9653db7f20cf9bc4b4c7593456cfdd40460434f: all 15 #200 suites plus `tests/security/wiring.test.js` and integrity scanner: **17 suites / 396 tests / 0 skipped PASS (75.691s)**, normal setup. The new multipart compressed-size proof passes on preview and commit with zero writes. The preceding 395-pass/1-fail log is retained; only the new test's missing real workbench mount was corrected, with its 400/code/zero-write assertions unchanged.
- Prior normal unfiltered Windows/Linux runs at a965: 343/345 suites and 5279/5294 tests PASS, 15 FAIL in the two actual retained UI/workspace setup gaps. Both logs retained. The real child-module/FormData loader and additive fixture installers now preserve all existing assertions. Broader00da group: 519/520 PASS, zero skips; scanner-only closed import syntax corrected at current cfb076a0. Current19-suite plus unfiltered owned run and CI38050708222/Docker gates remain pending. No ready-for-audit or full-green claim.
- Protected owned/retained/working databases remain byte-identical in completed groups: 6d216ef2 / 6fa171ad / 490b8c47. Logs/receipts and earlier new-fixture failures are retained.

Migration `20261010000100_instrument_import_templates` is additive: two immutable tables/guards and nullable restrictive `WorkItemDraft.importReceiptId`, native ALTER with no draft rebuild/backfill. The real explicit-path installer has dry-run, exact schema/source refusal, an IMMEDIATE transaction, original row/schema/FK preservation and one installation receipt; repeated apply/startup are read-only. Actual default entrypoint and Docker package all four digest-bound source assets. Original historical89 and independently emitted current-main92 schema-only fixtures are both retained with closed callers/digests.

Populated owned predecessor: 95 original tables, 2 Samples, 2 WorkItems, 1 Result, 1 WorkAttempt, 1 raw draft, 1 QC measurement, 1 QC evaluation, 9 AuditLogs, 6 BatchEvents and 28 prior receipts preserved. Dry-run 0 changes; apply adds 1 installation receipt, **0 templates, 0 import receipts, 0 draft links, 0 backfills**; repeated apply 0. Retained before/after backups keep exact hashes and integrity/FK checks pass. No production migration/backfill/deploy has run; #190's disk/YY host hold remains absolute.

Dependency gate: **saxes 6.0.0 (ISC)** is promoted from the existing exact development lock; exact transitive **xmlchars 2.2.0 (MIT)** is retained. Upstream saxes is archived; October 10 GitHub Advisory Database queries found no matching advisories for either. Existing repository findings are unchanged. The client `xlsx@0.18.5` is not used for these untrusted uploads. **Explicit YY approval of this concrete parser choice is required before merge** per pin6095961328; none is claimed. ZIP decoding uses built-in Node zlib, not a new ZIP dependency.

XLSX caps: 16 MiB compressed/upload, 64 MiB total uncompressed, 4096 ZIP entries, 250000 XML nodes, depth64, 4096 merge ranges. Ordinary stored/deflated single-disk ZIP only; ZIP64/encrypted/unsupported forms refuse. No extraction, formula execution, external loading or DTD/entity expansion. Macro/external/malformed files and scaled/date/error/unsupported cells have pinned stable refusals and zero-write tests; multiple/hidden sheets require an exact selection. The new real multipart compressed-size boundary test is included at this head.

Precedent: standing agreement6089928620 (closed fixtures, digests, independent Prisma oracles, additive installers). Scope pins6091749530 / 6094747629 / 6095469488 / 6095652486 / 6096085980 / 6096218065 / 6095961328; latest numeric rule6096643904 supersedes earlier numeric-storage pins. See `docs/audit/200-instrument-import.md` for behavior and evidence.

Deferred: calculated QC (#213), QUDT authority follow-up (#283), unit/dilution conversion, formula execution, alternative XLSX readers and scientific defaults. #210 corrections are retained.
